records.jp: そういえば、歓迎会してなかったよね
records.en_original: Hey, I just realized that we never had a welcome party.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, I just realized that we never had a welcome party.
records.en: Come to think of it, we never held a welcome party, did we?

records.jp: あー！　忘れてた！<CR>くそっ、あたしとしたことが
records.en_original: Ahh crap! I totally forgot! What have I done!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh crap! I totally forgot! What have I done!
records.en: Ah! I forgot!<CR>Damn it, how could I let that happen?

records.jp: 誰の？
records.en_original: A welcome party? For whom?
records.en_auxiliary: A welcome party? For whom?
records.en: Whose?

records.jp: みんなの。わたしたちは前からいるけど、<CR>愛央ちゃんたちが来たのは最近でしょ？
records.en_original: Everyone. The three of us have been here a while, but Ao and the rest only came recently, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone. The three of us have been here a while, but Ao and the rest only came recently, right?
records.en: Everyone's. We've been here from the start,<CR>but Ao-chan and the others only arrived recently, right?

records.jp: だから伶那とこころとあたしで<CR>盛大にやろうと思ってたのに
records.en_original: So I thought the three of us should throw a big party for the newcomers.
records.en_auxiliary: So I thought the three of us should throw a big party for the newcomers.
records.en: So I thought Rena, Kokoro, and I could<CR>throw a huge welcome party.

records.jp: 勝手に主催者に入れられてるんだけど
records.en_original: Why am I getting roped into planning this?
records.en_auxiliary: Why am I getting roped into planning this?
records.en: You've made me one of the organizers without asking.

records.jp: だってウチら初期メンじゃん？<CR>ずっとさんこいちで頑張ってきたじゃん
records.en_original: We're the first generation! We've always been a trio!
records.en_auxiliary: We're the first generation! We've always been a trio!
records.en: Come on, we're the original members, aren't we?<CR>The three of us have always been a package deal.

records.jp: そういう暑苦しい関係っていうより……
records.en_original: I don't think that's how I'd describe it. I'd say we're more like...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think that's how I'd describe it. I'd say we're more like...
records.en: I wouldn't call it something that intense...

records.jp: 家族、かな？
records.en_original: A family?
records.en_auxiliary: A family?
records.en: Maybe... a family?

records.jp: お、いい例え！　こころがお母さんで、<CR>伶那はお父さん、であたしが一人娘って感じ？
records.en_original: Ooh, I like that! Kokoro's the mom, Rena's the dad, and I'm the daughter!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, I like that! Kokoro's the mom, Rena's the dad, and I'm the daughter!
records.en: Ooh, good comparison! Kokoro's the mom,<CR>Rena's the dad, and I'm their only daughter?

records.jp: 誰がお父さんよ。<CR>それにあなたは娘っていうより、ペットの犬でしょ
records.en_original: Why am I the father? Besides, I think you're more like a pet dog than a daughter.
records.en_auxiliary: Why am I the father? Besides, I think you're more like a pet dog than a daughter.
records.en: Who's the dad?<CR>And you're more of a pet dog than a daughter.

records.jp: ふん、もういいもん。<CR>あたし一人で歓迎会開くもん
records.en_original: Hmph, fine. I'll just throw the welcome party by myself.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph, fine. I'll just throw the welcome party by myself.
records.en: Hmph, fine.<CR>I'll hold the welcome party all by myself.

records.jp: 愛央はどんなのがいい？
records.en_original: What kind of party would you like, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of party would you like, Ao?
records.en: What kind would you like, Ao?

records.jp: それ、私に聞く？
records.en_original: It's not gonna be a surprise?
records.en_auxiliary: It's not gonna be a surprise?
records.en: You're asking me that?

records.jp: あくまで参考にするだけだよ
records.en_original: Just to get some ideas.
records.en_auxiliary: Just to get some ideas.
records.en: Just to get some ideas.

records.jp: 勇希はどんなのを考えてるの？
records.en_original: What do you have in mind, Yuki?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you have in mind, Yuki?
records.en: What kind are you thinking of, Yuki?

records.jp: えっとねー、水風船に絵具を入れてー
records.en_original: Well, first we'd fill a bunch of water balloons up with paint—
records.en_auxiliary: Well, first we'd fill a bunch of water balloons up with paint—
records.en: Let's see, we'd fill water balloons with paint...

records.jp: やめて
records.en_original: Stop right there.
records.en_auxiliary: Stop right there.
records.en: Stop.

records.jp: 伶那には聞いてないですー
records.en_original: I'm not talking to you, Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not talking to you, Rena.
records.en: I wasn't asking you, Renaa.

records.jp: 学校の敷地内でするなら<CR>私にも口出しする権利があるでしょ
records.en_original: As long as this party takes place on school grounds, I have the right to speak.
records.en_auxiliary: As long as this party takes place on school grounds, I have the right to speak.
records.en: If you're doing it on school grounds,<CR>I have every right to have a say.

records.jp: 私だったら、映画か手作りのプラネタリウムの<CR>上映会にするけど
records.en_original: If it were up to me, I'd show a movie or make a home-made planetarium.
records.en_auxiliary: If it were up to me, I'd show a movie or make a home-made planetarium.
records.en: If it were up to me, I'd show a movie<CR>or put on a homemade planetarium show.

records.jp: 星は空見ればいいじゃん
records.en_original: You can just look at the sky if you wanna see the stars.
records.en_auxiliary: You can just look at the sky if you wanna see the stars.
records.en: If you want to see stars, just look at the sky.

records.jp: それとこれとは趣が違うの
records.en_original: It's not the same.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not the same.
records.en: That has a different charm.

records.jp: わたしはご飯をバイキング形式で出したいな。<CR>チョコレートファウンテンとかも用意して
records.en_original: I wanna have a buffet, with a chocolate fondue fountain and everything.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanna have a buffet, with a chocolate fondue fountain and everything.
records.en: I'd like to serve the food buffet-style.<CR>We could prepare a chocolate fountain too.

records.jp: くっ、ふつーに良い案
records.en_original: Dang it, that's a great idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Dang it, that's a great idea.
records.en: Damn, that's actually a really good idea.

records.jp: 星崎さんは誰の案がいいと思う？
records.en_original: Whose idea do you like best, Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: Whose idea do you like best, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Whose idea do you think is best, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 勇希かな。<CR>なんか楽しそうだし
records.en_original: I like Yuki's idea. It actually sounds like a lot of fun!
records.en_auxiliary: I like Yuki's idea. It actually sounds like a lot of fun!
records.en: Yuki's, I guess.<CR>It sounds fun.

records.jp: だっしょー？　<CR>愛央ならワンチャンそう言ってくれるって思ってた！
records.en_original: Right? I thought you might like it!
records.en_auxiliary: Right? I thought you might like it!
records.en: Right?<CR>I thought there was a chance you'd say that!

records.jp: 白いＴシャツ着て投げ合って、<CR>色がついた面積の多い人が負けってルール。どう？
records.en_original: We'll put on white T-shirts and throw balloons at each other, then whoever has the most color on their shirt at the end is the loser. How's that?
records.en_auxiliary: We'll put on white T-shirts and throw balloons at each other, then whoever has the most color on their shirt at the end is the loser. How's that?
records.en: We wear white T-shirts and throw them at each other.<CR>Whoever has the most paint on them loses. What do you think?

records.jp: 上手く絵具を選べば、<CR>負けても綺麗なＴシャツが出来上がりそう
records.en_original: If we choose the right paint, we might get a pretty T-shirt out of it even if we lose!
records.en_auxiliary: If we choose the right paint, we might get a pretty T-shirt out of it even if we lose!
records.en: If we choose the colors well,<CR>even the loser might end up with a pretty T-shirt.

records.jp: よし、伶那たちにはそこを宣伝しよう
records.en_original: I bet we can get the others on board if we tell them that.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet we can get the others on board if we tell them that.
records.en: All right, let's sell Rena and the others on that part.

records.jp: 伶那さんかな。<CR>手作りのプラネタリウム気になる
records.en_original: I like Rena's idea. I'm curious about what a homemade planetarium would be like.
records.en_auxiliary: I like Rena's idea. I'm curious about what a homemade planetarium would be like.
records.en: Rena-san's, I think.<CR>I'm curious about a homemade planetarium.

records.jp: 材料があれば、だけど。<CR>まぁ、考えとく
records.en_original: We'd need the materials, of course. But... I'm sure we'll think of something.
records.en_auxiliary: We'd need the materials, of course. But... I'm sure we'll think of something.
records.en: Only if we have the materials.<CR>Well, I'll think about it.

records.jp: アナウンスも伶那さんがやってくれるの？<CR>「これは夏の大三角形で……」みたいなやつ
records.en_original: Will you do the narration too, Rena? "Here we have Vega, Deneb, and Altair, the three stars of the Summer Triangle..." or something like that?
records.en_auxiliary: Will you do the narration too, Rena? "Here we have Vega, Deneb, and Altair, the three stars of the Summer Triangle..." or something like that?
records.en: Will you do the narration too, Rena-san?<CR>Like, 'This is the Summer Triangle...' or something?

records.jp: やりません
records.en_original: No.
records.en_auxiliary: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: ちぇー
records.en_original: Aww...
records.en_auxiliary: Aww...
records.en: Aww.

records.jp: （でもこの感じ、押したらやってくれそうだな）
records.en_original: (I bet she'd do it if I bugged her about it.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I bet she'd do it if I bugged her about it.)
records.en: (I bet she'd do it if I pushed her.)

records.jp: こころかな。<CR>チョコレートファウンテンには抗えないって
records.en_original: Gotta go with Kokoro. I can't say no to a chocolate fountain.
records.en_auxiliary: Gotta go with Kokoro. I can't say no to a chocolate fountain.
records.en: Kokoro's.<CR>I can't resist a chocolate fountain.

records.jp: 気に入ってもらえてよかった。<CR>愛央ちゃん、そういうの好きかなって思ってたんだ
records.en_original: I knew you'd like the idea.
records.en_auxiliary: I knew you'd like the idea.
records.en: I'm glad you liked it.<CR>I thought Ao-chan might like that kind of thing.

records.jp: なんでわかったの？
records.en_original: How did you know?
records.en_auxiliary: How did you know?
records.en: How did you know?

records.jp: 前にチーズフォンデュとか、ソフトクリーム絞るのとか<CR>楽しそうにしてたから
records.en_original: You seemed to really enjoy the cheese fondue and doing your own soft-serve ice cream.
records.en_auxiliary: You seemed to really enjoy the cheese fondue and doing your own soft-serve ice cream.
records.en: You seemed to have fun with the cheese fondue and<CR>dispensing your own soft-serve ice cream before.

records.jp: （嬉しいけど、子供っぽいとこ見られてて<CR>恥ずかしい……）
records.en_original: (It's kind of embarrassing they noticed how childish my eating habits are...but I am kinda happy.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's kind of embarrassing they noticed how childish my eating habits are...but I am kinda happy.)
records.en: (I'm happy, but it's embarrassing<CR>that she saw my childish side...)

records.jp: まぁ、みんなの案全盛りにしてもらってもいいけどね
records.en_original: Now that I think about it, there's nothing holding us back from doing all three.
records.en_auxiliary: Now that I think about it, there's nothing holding us back from doing all three.
records.en: Though I wouldn't mind if they went all-out and did every idea.

records.jp: うんうん、それも面白いかも
records.en_original: Hmm, yeah. That could be fun!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, yeah. That could be fun!
records.en: Mm-hm, that might be fun too.

records.jp: よし、まずは美術室に行って……
records.en_original: First we need as much paint as we can carry!
records.en_auxiliary: First we need as much paint as we can carry!
records.en: All right, first let's go to the art room...

records.jp: それだけは絶対に阻止するから
records.en_original: Stop right there.
records.en_auxiliary: Stop right there.
records.en: That one thing I will absolutely stop.
